user.title: Create Mock Solar simulator
user.description: Create a local energy simulator. No hardware or credentials are needed. Starts in manual mode; enable dynamic simulation to advance battery SOC. Values reset to defaults when the integration reloads or Home Assistant restarts.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Mock Solar simulator is supported.

init.title: Mock Solar dashboard
init.description: Create an editable Energy Lab dashboard. Existing dashboard edits are preserved. Turning this off leaves any dashboard already created in place. Use the Regenerate dashboard button to explicitly replace its layout.
